fetched_notes: No body text recovered. Only the headline is available: 'Over 3,000 cases closed without indictment | The numbers behind sex offenses', byline Hodaya Ran, walla, 17 Nov 2026 16:17. The audit subagent should treat the headline's '3,000+ cases closed without indictment' (re: sex-offense cases) as the claim to verify via web search for the underlying police/State Prosecution/Ministry of Justice statistics, and should record source_unreadable or source_not_found as appropriate if the primary report can't be independently located or if the article itself can't be read to confirm time period/scope.

claims_seed.claim: Over 3,000 sex-offense cases were closed without indictment (period and scope unknown from headline alone)

claims.claim: מעל 3,000 תיקים נסגרו ללא אישום (בעבירות מין)
claims.source_figure: Latest readable prosecution data (2024): 3,188 sex-offense/harassment files closed without indictment out of 3,894 final decisions. 2025 data (report of 18 Nov 2026) not readable in primary form; press reports 623 indictments and 82% closure, implying roughly 2,750-2,940 closures (≈623/0.18×0.82, given rounding) — i.e. below 3,000 if those two press figures are exact and refer to the same base.
claims.note: Article body unrecoverable, so the year the headline refers to is unknown. If it cites 2024 data the claim is accurate (3,188); if it cites 2025 data, press-reported figures imply a count under 3,000 — cannot be resolved until the 2026 report PDF is reachable. Regardless of year, 'closed without indictment' bundles all closure grounds (the source gives no breakdown by evidence/guilt/public interest) and is measured against final decisions, not files opened.

body_recovery_attempts: Exact-Hebrew-headline and byline web searches: no hit for the article. archive.org: no snapshot (Wayback availability API empty for /news/law/383961821). Live URL still 301 -> https://www.walla.co.il/.
scope_note: Not the 'official registry / factual tally' exclusion: the figure is a State Prosecution statistic (closures without indictment) whose meaning depends on denominator (final decisions vs. files opened), data year, and closure definition (excludes conditional arrangements; no reason breakdown published) — exactly the kind of figure that can be misread. Headline 'המספרים מאחורי' frames it as data analysis.

primary_sources.name: איגוד מרכזי הסיוע — דוח שנתי 2026 (2025 data, State Prosecution figures)
primary_sources.note: Report released 18 Nov 2026 per Maariv/Haaretz/Israel Hayom coverage; not posted on 1202.org.il (2026-annual-report page 404; WP media library has only cover images for 2026/11). Haaretz paywalled; Israel Hayom 403.

primary_sources.name: איגוד מרכזי הסיוע — דוח שנתי 2025 (2024 data), ch. 'נתוני פרקליטות המדינה' pp.31-33
primary_sources.note: 3,894 final decisions; 706 indictments; 3,188 files 'נגנזו ... ללא הגשת כתב אישום'; 81-82% closed. Footnote: % based on final decisions in the year, not files opened; excludes conditional arrangements (~1-2%). Data originally given by the Prosecution to the Knesset Constitution Committee (11 Nov 2025); MoJ did not answer the FOI request. No breakdown by closure reason (lack of evidence / no guilt / public interest).

primary_sources.name: Maariv coverage of 2026 report
primary_sources.note: 2025: prosecution opened 4,517 files (-2.5%); 623 indictments (~-6.5%); 82% of files with final decision closed without indictment; no absolute closure count given. Also cites 6,678 files (police+prosecution?), inconsistent with 4,517.
